text:

title: A nice day trip
text: We enjoyed both tours especially since they were small, family owned businesses.  The olive oil and wine were exceptional.
author: Karen_L

title: Highly Recommended Tour - Everything Tasty
text:
We had a wonderful time on this tour; thank you, Melanie!  

The tour was private, just GF and I, in a private car.  Melanie was wonderful and knowledgable and the food and wine were delicious and seemed authentic.  The locations were carefully selected and took us to some off the beaten path places.  The tours we received were extensive and thorough; the guides were happy to  answer our many questions.  The olive oil and chocolate we bought are amazing.

If you have an opportunity to work with Melanie and her company, do it!  I would repeat this exact same tour in a heartbeat.
author: lolathemustang

title: Great tour / experience
text: Loved this tour!  Fantastic wat to end our trip!  We have never done an olive oil tasting before and this was very interesting and fun.  The winery was beautiful and I enjoyed every wine we tasted!  I highly recommend this tour!
author: Deann_W

title: Wonderful day tasting olive oil and wine
text: Our olive oil and wine tour was wonderful.  Our guide took care of everything, the tours and tastings at each location were fascinating and delicious.  It was a day enjoyed by the whole family!
